def _split_marker(requirement: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
    """Split a PEP 508 requirement into (requirement, marker)."""
    requirement = requirement.strip()
    if ";" in requirement:
        requirement, marker = requirement.split(";", 1)
        return requirement.strip(), marker.strip() or None
    return requirement, None

def _parse_requirement(requirement: str, group: str | None = None) -> DependencySpec:
    """Parse a PEP 508 requirement string into a :class:`DependencySpec`.

    The requirement is split into an optional environment marker (following
    ``;``), a package name, and a version specifier.  Extras (``name[extra]``)
    are not represented by :class:`DependencySpec` and are therefore dropped.
    """
    requirement, marker = _split_marker(requirement)

    match = _REQUIREMENT_RE.match(requirement)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid requirement: {requirement!r}")

    name = match.group(1)
    constraint = match.group(2).strip() or "*"

    if constraint.startswith("(") and constraint.endswith(")"):
